svg.title: Read your writes in an Egres cluster: the follower that owns the session forwards a write to the leader, stores the commit timestamp, and holds a later read until it has applied the log to that timestamp
svg.desc: A sequence diagram with three lifelines: client, follower and leader. The client sends an insert to the follower. The follower forwards it to the leader, which commits it through Raft at timestamp 1042 and returns that timestamp. The follower stores 1042 as the session timestamp and acknowledges the client. The client then sends a select. The follower has only applied the log up to 1039, so it waits while it applies 1040, 1041 and 1042, then runs the read locally and returns rows that include the new order.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: EGRES · READ YOUR WRITES · THE SESSION LIVES ON THE NODE YOU CONNECTED TO
